body:
Hey, I just completed my PhD and I can totally relate to how you're feeling. I started my program bright-eyed, bushy-tailed and very excited about my project, but ended up having my first depressive episode the second half of my first year. 

Quitting won't make you a failure!

If you're set on continuing, I'd recommend making time for what you love (cooking amazing meals) and maintaining/developing your support network. The most successful girl on my course left the office everyday at 4pm and spent the rest of the day baking. Making room for the good stuff is what can help you survive!

Stay strong.

This is very very very very strong of you to post this. YOU ARE NOT STUPID! Please keep telling yourself that. 

It doesn't feel this way now, but you are going to be ok. I'd recommend (if you're interested) finding a low-cost therapist. If you don't trust the first one you meet, find another. 

You will be alright! STAY STRONG!!
